title: Ravens to sign tight end Durham Smythe

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ravens to sign tight end Durham Smythe
sources.description: The Ravens lost both of their incumbent tight ends on the first day of free agency, as Isaiah Likely signed with the New York Giants and Charlie Kolar joined the Los Angeles Chargers. General Manager Eric DeCosta moved quickly to start backfilling the depth chart, agreeing to terms with veteran Durham Smythe on Wednesday. Smythe […]
